steps.title: Identify audio focus collision causing instant pause on play
steps.description: Analyzed AudioManager focus requests in BackgroundAudioService that were stealing focus from WebView's internal media renderer and causing Chromium to pause video playback.

steps.title: Eliminate focus thrashing in BackgroundAudioService
steps.description: Updated updatePlaybackState and audio focus acquisition logic to prevent recursive playback state toggles when HTML5 video starts playing.

steps.title: Optimize Page Visibility API JS injection
steps.description: Overrode document.hidden, document.visibilityState, and event listeners to prevent YouTube scripts from executing programmatic pause calls when media is launched.

steps.title: Refine HTML5 video event bridge synchronization
steps.description: Updated JavaScript bridge listeners to ensure continuous audio streaming when app is backgrounded or screen state changes.
